The competitor's new loyalty program poses a significant threat to our business. By integrating discounts, rewards, and personalized experiences directly into their mobile app, they are creating a high-friction barrier to switching for our customers. This seamless integration likely enhances user engagement and convenience, which are key drivers of retention. If successful, this strategy will likely increase their customer loyalty while causing a measurable decline in our customer base, as clients may prioritize the added value and ease of use offered by the competitor. We should consider accelerating our own digital engagement initiatives or enhancing our value proposition to mitigate this risk.
